create_Setup_from_str: parse a benchmark summary string into a Setup object with faults, nodes, and rate
create_Result_from_str: parse a benchmark summary string into a Result object with TPS and latency
aggregate_Result: aggregate multiple Result objects into a single Result with mean and standard deviation
create_LogAggregator: create a LogAggregator that reads benchmark result files and parses SUMMARY sections into records
print_LogAggregator: print aggregated benchmark results to organized files for latency and TPS analysis
